regions.name: explorer1
regions.rationale: Focus on high sensitivity with moderate speed by using longer seeds and lower cap values to capture more unique seeds, while keeping gap parameters to ensure thorough coverage.

regions.name: explorer2
regions.rationale: Optimize for speed with shorter seeds and higher cap values to reduce computational load, while maintaining reasonable gap parameters to avoid missing important alignments.

regions.name: explorer3
regions.rationale: Balance between sensitivity and speed by using medium seeds and cap values, with moderate gap parameters to ensure coverage without excessive computation.
